audit.why: Even-to-slightly-favoured lane (52.97% WR, 2724 games): Naafiri wins early/mid stages, Ahri outscales at two+ items. Existing diff EVEN 5.5/10 is fair.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike named 'Call of the Pack' in content; on the live kit W is The Call of the Pack and the level 6 ult is Hounds' Pursuit (900-range lock-on dash, recast shield).
audit.why: Riot kit file: R = Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s; W = The Call of the Pack 26-18s untargetable empower.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and spikes[1].text rewritten with Hounds' Pursuit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer references a 'cooldown silence' Ahri does not have, treats Naafiri W as a 'lock-on dive' (that is R), and breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers. Charm (12s flat) instantly stops movement abilities — it interrupts Naafiri's E and R dashes mid-flight, the decisive interaction. Ahri Q return is true damage; her P heals off minions (anti-heal-relevant chip sustain).
audit.why: Ahri E text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'; Charm CD 12s, R 140/120/100s vs Naafiri R 110s.
audit.corrected: Charm-stops-dash stated across tldr/winCon/enemyWin/dontsFull; real cooldowns added.

audit.why: Charm 12s and Spirit Rush 140s are the punishable windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions: Ahri P sustain (Grievous Wounds timing) and Q true-damage return (MR stacking is the wrong answer).
audit.corrected: P sustain folded into breakdown.early; true damage into dontsFull[2].d. MR-stacking note recorded here — no report slot left under the two-entry cap.
